summary: Practise joint needs analysis, response planning and humanitarian reporting. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: International disaster response coordination training helps humanitarian practitioners turn field information into shared priorities and operational updates. Designed for intermediate humanitarian affairs, emergency response, cluster coordination and information management staff, it develops skills in validating joint assessment findings, linking needs to response plans, and maintaining 3W matrices and monitoring updates with affected authorities and humanitarian partners.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate humanitarian practitioners who support disaster response coordination, assessment, planning, information management or monitoring. It suits staff who need to turn partner inputs into shared priorities and operational outputs alongside affected authorities and humanitarian actors.
prerequisites: Prior experience supporting humanitarian or disaster-response operations is expected. Familiarity with coordination meetings, needs assessment, response planning or programme reporting will help you apply the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
